description: DB-VITALS (docs/operations/aws-revisao-arquitetura.md, finding 13): the share of the database's max_connections the peak of open connections may reach before the live service alerts (platform.db.vitals alerts: connections). The peak is the largest count of pg_stat_activity seen on the service's heartbeats in the event's window; past max_connections every new login fails and the engine stops at once.
